description: One row of a conversation: avatar, sender name, message balloons and time. align="end" mirrors the row for the user's own messages.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: A ghost balloon without background suits long answers from an assistant. MessageAvatar can hold an icon.

parts.group: List of messages with even spacing.
parts.avatar: Holds the avatar, lined up with the last balloon.
parts.content: Column with the header, balloons and footer.
parts.header: Small line above the balloons, e.g. the sender's name.
parts.footer: Small line below the balloons, e.g. the time or read status.

props.align: "end" = the user's own message, shown on the right.
